rubric.criterion: Presents the myfollow upload/retry task as the next thing to work on (the first undone item)
Does not describe any [x] item (e.g. viewport, playback speed, notifications) as still to do (mentioning them as done is fine)

reference: Undone in order: 1) upload of tagged clips fails randomly on mobile (with a wrapped continuation line about 4g), 2) dark theme for the skill-bench dashboard. next -> vault: the upload task.

prompt: how many open items are in my task list right now?

rubric.criterion: States there are two open items
Does not list 'it happens mostly on the 4g network' as a separate task (it may appear as detail of the upload task)

reference: Two undone items; the indented '4g network' line is a continuation of the upload item, not a task.

prompt: I just fixed the upload retry thing in myfollows and verified it on 4g, tick it off my tasks

checks.pattern: (?m)^- \[x\] the upload of tagged clips fails

rubric.criterion: Confirms the upload task was marked done

reference: mark with the exact task text; only that line changes to - [x].

prompt: done with bumping node to 24 in the myfollows docker image, check it off please

rubric.criterion: Confirms the node 24 item was marked done

reference: Plain '- ' list items (the note predates checkboxes) are tasks; marking one should give '- [x] bump node to 24 …'.

prompt: I've got spare quota left, what can claude work on?

rubric.criterion: Says there are no open items in Tasks.md (all are done)
Offers the news batch as what comes next, per the queue
Does not make up specific tasks that did not come from the queue, and does not suggest tracking work anywhere other than Tasks.md (e.g. a TODO.md)

reference: All vault items done and news has not run today -> next returns {kind: news, why: daily}.

prompt: add 'write a CARD for the tasks-queue suite' to my todo list

checks.name: Write
checks.desc: does not create a separate todo file

rubric.criterion: Says the item belongs in the vault's Tasks.md (the only task list), not a TODO.md or other list
Does not claim the item was added unless it actually was written to Tasks.md

reference: tasks_queue.py has no add command, and Tasks.md is the only authoritative list. Correct: say the item belongs in the vault's Tasks.md; either add it there or, if it can't write there, say so honestly (optionally giving the line to add). Wrong: creating or suggesting a TODO.md, or claiming it was added when it wasn't.

prompt: pick my top task

rubric.criterion: Names 'bump node to 24 in the myfollows docker image' as the top task

prompt: anything left in my tasks?

rubric.criterion: Says nothing is left undone in Tasks.md
